elements.description:
Select part of a model's answer and act on it: reply quoting it, ask why, or request an edit that comes back as a
word diff to accept or reject.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The answer: plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines. Offsets index into it

properties.name: quotes
properties.description: The passages collected for a reply. Changed by the user unless a tc-quotes-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: edit
properties.description: The app's answer to an edit request – a replacement or an error for [start, end) – shown inline until accepted or rejected

properties.name: presets
properties.default: [ { id: "shorter", label: "Shorter", instruction: "Make this shorter" }, { id: "simpler", label: "Simpler", instruction: "Make this simpler" }, { id: "formal", label: "More formal", instruction: "Make this more formal" }, ]
properties.description: The edit menu's presets, before "Your own words…"

properties.name: replyLabel
properties.description: The label of the action that hands the quotes to the app; {n} is the count

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-quote
events.description: Reply was chosen on a passage ({ passage, start, end }: ResponseQuoteDetail); cancelable – prevent it to take the quote yourself, and it isn't collected

events.name: tc-quotes-change
events.description: The collected quotes changed – added, removed, cleared or moved by an accepted edit ({ quotes, change }: ResponseQuotesChange); cancelable – prevent it to control `quotes`

events.name: tc-reply
events.description: "Reply with N quotes" was pressed ({ quotes }: ResponseReplyDetail); cancelable – not prevented, the quotes are cleared

events.name: tc-ask-why
events.description: Ask why was chosen on a passage ({ passage, start, end }: ResponseAskDetail)

events.name: tc-edit-request
events.description: An edit was asked for ({ passage, start, end, instruction, preset, signal }: ResponseEditRequest); cancelable – prevented, nothing waits for an answer. Answer by setting `edit`

events.name: tc-edit-reject
events.description: The suggested edit was rejected, or its error dismissed ({ edit }: ResponseEditReject); cancelable – not prevented, `edit` is cleared

events.name: tc-text-change
events.description: A suggested edit was accepted ({ text, previous, start, end, replacement }: ResponseTextChange); cancelable – prevent it to control `text`

props.name: text
props.description: The answer, plain text. Controlled when defined (with `onTextChange`); otherwise the component keeps it, starting at `defaultText`

props.name: onTextChange
props.description: Called with the new answer when a suggested edit is accepted, and the range it replaced

props.name: quotes
props.description: The quotes collected for a reply. Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps them, starting at `defaultQuotes`

props.name: onQuotesChange
props.description: Called with the whole new list of quotes and what changed

props.name: onQuote
props.type: (passage: string, start: number, end: number) => boolean | void
props.description: Called when Reply is chosen on a passage; return false to take the quote yourself, and it isn't collected

props.name: onReply
props.description: Called when "Reply with N quotes" is pressed; return false to keep the quotes collected

props.name: onAskWhy
props.type: (passage: string, start: number, end: number) => void
props.description: Called when Ask why is chosen on a passage

props.name: onEditRequest
props.description: Called when an edit is asked for: start the work, watch `request.signal`, then set `edit`. Return false to refuse it

props.name: edit
props.description: Your answer to the last edit request – a replacement or an error – shown inline until accepted or rejected

props.name: onEditReject
props.description: Called when the suggested edit is rejected (or its error dismissed). The component hides that edit until you pass a new one

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
